vllm bench serve \

caption: Traffic shaped like Anchorline's real load: question-plus-logs in, a short answer out.

eyebrow: Illustrative results -- before and after one change
code:
Baseline (max-num-seqs=64)
  Throughput: ~1,450 tok/s
  TTFT p50/p99: 410ms / 1,180ms  <- misses 500ms target
  Request p99:  3.9s

After tuning (max-num-seqs=96, gpu-mem-util=0.95)
  Throughput: ~1,890 tok/s
  TTFT p50/p99: 380ms / 720ms
  Request p99:  2.6s
caption: A wide p50-to-p99 gap points at queuing under burst load, not a slow model.

eyebrow: The discipline that makes it trustworthy

steps.label: Read the gap
steps.sub: p50 fine, p99 misses target -- queuing, not model speed

steps.label: Change ONE variable
steps.sub: e.g. max-num-seqs, or quantization -- never both

steps.label: Compare and decide
steps.sub: keep the change only if it closes the gap
